title: China's constitution text says the Communist Party leads the state
summary: China's constitution text says the Communist Party leads the state.
body: Article 1 of the English compilation describes the People's Republic as a socialist state under the people's democratic dictatorship, led by the working class and based on the alliance of workers and peasants, and states the leadership of the Communist Party of China. The source says: "The People's Republic of China is a socialist state under the people's democratic dictatorship led by the working class and based on the alliance of workers and peasants. The socialist system is the basic system of the People's Republic of China. The leadership of the Communist Party of China is the defining feature of socialism with Chinese characteristics. Sabotage of the socialist system by any organization or individual is prohibited." This card is that article's own sentence. It is not an independent measurement of how power is exercised, and it is not a finding from outside the document.

sources.title: Constitution of the People's Republic of China, Constitute Project English text (2018 compilation)
